blocks.title: Digital Experience Monitoring
blocks.description: Understand your website from the outside in with Synthetic Monitoring and the inside out with Frontend Observability.

blocks.content: Replace your-stack with your Grafana Cloud stack slug and yourcompany.com with your website. For Frontend Observability, run the command from your frontend project directory. Requires Node.js 22.6 or later.

blocks.label: Prefer a guided setup in Grafana?

blocks.content: Start with either product and add the other whenever you are ready.
